events.headline: US strikes Iran's Larak Island in Strait of Hormuz, killing two
events.summary: A US strike hit Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, killing two people and injuring two others. This marks the first known US strike since late July and the first exchange of strikes between the US and Iran in weeks.

events.headline: China censors viral footage of deadly Tibet flood after Nepal disaster
events.summary: A deadly flood devastated communities along the China-Nepal border in Tibet, prompting Chinese authorities to erase viral footage of the disaster while state media flooded platforms with official content.

events.headline: Cameroonian youth deceived and deployed to fight in Russia's war in Ukraine
events.summary: Analysts report that economic desperation and fraudulent recruitment schemes are funneling young Cameroonians into the Russian military, resulting in deaths among recruits deployed to fight in Ukraine.

events.headline: Canada faces new US tariffs after Carney refuses to match US levies on China
events.summary: Canada is facing new US import penalties after Prime Minister Mark Carney refused to match US tariffs on China, escalating a trade dispute between Washington and Ottawa. Other countries are reportedly watching the clash as a test case over economic sovereignty.

events.headline: Masked Israeli settlers attack Palestinian homes in West Bank village of Qusra
events.summary: Masked Israeli settlers launched an attack on Palestinian homes, their first major attack since initiating a siege of the village of Qusra earlier in the month. The attacks drew rare criticism from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

events.headline: Russian missile and drone attack on Kyiv kills at least four
events.summary: A large-scale Russian missile and drone attack struck Kyiv and its surrounding region overnight, killing at least four people and wounding more than a dozen, according to Ukrainian officials. The strike came as children prepared to return to school amid heightened fears of further attacks.

events.headline: US and Iran exchange strikes overnight, ending month-long lull in six-month war
events.summary: The US and Iran traded strikes overnight after a month-long pause, following earlier US strikes on an island in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump vowed to 'hit Iran hard' in response to the Iranian attacks on US targets in the Middle East, while Iran's president said further fighting was not in Iran's interest.

events.headline: Iran's FM accuses Netanyahu of tricking US into six-month war with Iran
events.summary: Iran's foreign minister accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of tricking the United States into war with Iran, six months into the conflict. An April ceasefire had ended intense fighting but sporadic attacks have continued, with no end to the conflict in sight.

events.headline: Former Israeli generals and officials accuse West Bank settlers of ethnic cleansing with government backing
events.summary: A growing number of former Israeli generals, intelligence officials and prime ministers are publicly accusing settlers in the West Bank of committing what they describe as 'Jewish Terrorism' and ethnic cleansing with government support. One unnamed former official warned that a society behaving this way is 'doomed'.

events.headline: Russia intensifies near-constant drone attacks on Kyiv, marking new phase of war
events.summary: Kyiv has experienced nearly constant air raids from Russian drones, a shift from previous years of largely overnight attacks, leaving residents exhausted and on edge. The change represents a new and more dangerous phase of the war in Ukraine.

events.headline: Ukrainian drone expert Fedorov, fired by Kyiv, to advise Italy's defense chief
events.summary: Mykhailo Fedorov, a former Ukrainian defense minister and drone warfare figure who was fired by Kyiv, has been appointed to advise Italy's defense chief. The move illustrates how other militaries are adapting to battlefield changes accelerated by the war in Ukraine.

events.headline: Pentagon office helps lead Trump administration's Venezuela oil deal
events.summary: The Defense Department's Office of Strategic Capital, originally founded under the Biden administration to provide loans supporting the US defense industry, is now helping lead President Trump's oil deal involving Venezuela.

events.headline: US invites Russia to G20 finance meeting focused on Iran war oil shock, Europe protests
events.summary: The United States invited Russia's finance minister to attend a G20 finance meeting focused on the economic shock from the war in Iran, which has driven up global oil prices. China and Russia are attending the meeting, prompting protests from European officials.

events.headline: UAE central bank to review Banque Misr branches after US Treasury sanctions over Iran links
events.summary: The U.S. Treasury Department accused Banque Misr's branches in the United Arab Emirates of helping Iran evade sanctions. The Emirati central bank promised to conduct an examination of the bank.

events.headline: US blockade and war strain Iran's fuel supply, causing long gas lines
events.summary: Iran is experiencing long lines for gasoline as war and a U.S. blockade squeeze fuel supply. The government is struggling to meet a shortfall in fuel and fears higher prices at the pump could trigger unrest.

events.headline: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in West Bank, prompting Netanyahu rebuke
events.summary: Israeli settlers carried out an intense assault against Palestinians in the West Bank on Saturday. The attack drew sharp condemnations from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and other officials.

events.headline: US takes majority control of Venezuelan oil reserves in controversial deal
events.summary: A deal gives the United States majority control of vast Venezuelan oil reserves. Venezuelans have criticized the arrangement as a new form of U.S. colonialism, seeing it as an affront to national identity.

events.headline: Russian strike kills 37 at weapons depot near Kyiv; Zelensky blames negligence
events.summary: A Russian strike on a weapons depot in a civilian area near Kyiv killed 37 people. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the depot's location in a civilian area 'definitely shouldn't have been there,' attributing the deaths partly to negligence.

events.headline: US-Canada trade talks collapse amid tariff dispute, Carney rallies nation
events.summary: Trade talks between the United States and Canada collapsed, prompting Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to rally the nation and Canadian businesses to take a defiant stance. President Trump separately moved to rename Lake Ontario amid the dispute.

events.headline: Canada-US trade war continues as Carney maintains withdrawal from negotiations
events.summary: The trade war between the United States and Canada has continued, with Canadians rallying behind Prime Minister Mark Carney's decision to walk away from negotiations with the Trump administration. Questions remain over how and when talks might resume.

events.headline: Trump to meet US oil executives amid Iran war-driven fuel price spike ahead of midterms
events.summary: US President Donald Trump will meet oil refining executives at the White House as he seeks to control fuel prices that have spiked due to the ongoing Iran war, ahead of November midterm elections. The meeting follows Trump's announcement of a deal for a large US stake in Venezuela's oil reserves.

events.headline: India rejects Hague court ruling ordering it to uphold Indus Waters Treaty with Pakistan
events.summary: The Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague ruled that India must uphold the water-sharing treaty with Pakistan that it suspended amid bilateral tensions, and must limit work on a hydroelectric plant it is building in Kashmir. India suspended the treaty, which ensures water supply to 80% of Pakistani farms, in April last year.

events.headline: China criticizes Japan's hypersonic and underwater drone weapon plans as regional threat
events.summary: China has criticized Japan's plans to arm submarine drones with long-range missiles and test hypersonic weapons in Australia, in its latest swipe at Tokyo's military build-up. Analysts say the moves could threaten PLA Navy amphibious groups and surface combatants within the 'first island chain'.

events.headline: Xi Jinping visits Egypt, deepening China-Egypt ties amid Western balancing act
events.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping visited Egypt for the first time in a decade, as Beijing deepens economic, military and diplomatic ties with Cairo and seeks closer cooperation on Middle East and Africa crises. The visit follows Xi's trip to Kyrgyzstan for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit.

events.headline: Ontario Premier Doug Ford urges thaw in US-Canada trade war
events.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford called for a thaw in the U.S.-Canada trade war, criticizing President Trump while speaking warmly of the American people. Ford described the two countries as 'best friends'.

events.headline: Unconfirmed PLA Naval Exercise Reports Near Taiwan Surface on Chinese Forums
